children: RNS Number : 0894U  Vanquis Banking Group PLC  09 September 2026

The Company announces that, on the 8th September 2026, 615,092 of the ordinary shares of 20 8/11p ('Shares') awarded to Ian McLaughlin, Chief Executive Officer, as nil-cost options under the Vanquis Banking Group 2020 Restricted Share Plan ('Plan') granted on 8 September 2023 have vested.

289,094 of those Shares have been withheld by the Company to satisfy the income tax, national insurance contributions and fees due on vesting. Ian McLaughlin has acquired 325,998 vested Shares which will be subject to a minimum two-year holding period under the Plan rules.
